name: What should I prepare before an interior storm repair contractor arrives?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before an interior storm repair contractor arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your contractor arrives, document all visible damage by taking comprehensive photos and videos of walls, ceilings, flooring, and belongings. Avoid discarding damaged baseboards, cabinetry, or sheetrock until your insurance adjuster or repair specialist has inspected them. Locate your homeowners insurance policy number, note the exact time water entered the home, and clear a direct walking path from the entrance to the damaged rooms so the crew can safely bring in moisture meters, drying equipment, and tools.
acceptedAnswer.description: Take detailed photos of all damaged materials, keep your insurance policy handy, and clear access paths so the crew can inspect studs and setup drying gear.
